statement: Let A1 be the Artin group of a Coxeter matrix m1 on a finite set Σ1, and choose a vertex σ1 ∈ Σ1. For each n ≥ 2, adjoin new vertices σ2, . . . , σn and let An be the Artin group of the Coxeter matrix mn on Σn = Σ1 ⊔{σ2, . . . , σn}. Retain m1 on Σ1, put diagonal entries equal to 1, and set the remaining off-diagonal entries, symmetrically, by mn(σj, σj+1) = 3 (1 ≤ j < n), mn(σj, σℓ) = 2 (1 ≤ j < ℓ ≤ n, ℓ − j ≥ 2), mn(u, σj) = 2 (u ∈ Σ1 \ {σ1}, 2 ≤ j ≤ n). Let sn : An−1 ,→ An be the natural inclusion for n ≥ 2. For every n ≥ 2, every abelian group C, used as a constant coefficient group, and every integer i ≥ 0, the induced map (Bsn)∗ : Hi(BAn−1; C) −→ Hi(BAn; C) is an isomorphism when i < n/2 and a surjection when i = n/2.
